name: quuu
description: Task runner that manages AI agent runs
author: k-kinzal

scripts.build: npm run build:pty && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run --prefix ../.. mobile:build && electron-builder --mac --dir --config.electronVersion=$(node -p "require('electron/package.json').version")
scripts.dist:dmg: npm run build && npm run --prefix ../.. mobile:build && electron-builder --mac --publish never --config.electronVersion=$(node -p "require('electron/package.json').version")
